mapper.insert: INSERT INTO questBoard(writer, email, subject, password, ref, re_step, content) VALUES (#{writer}, #{email}, #{subject}, #{password}, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(r.ref) + 1, 1) FROM questBoard r), 1, 1, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM questBoard ORDER BY ref DESC, re_step ASC
